grading_role.prior_case_context: No inherited prior case outcomes or raw-answer context; reviewed only this exact grading packet and repository AGENTS.md. A separate fresh-context model-assisted second look reviewed the four q3 cases.
grading_role.limitations: Method labels were not inspected or joined. This is not human gold, independent human review, or a claim of statistical blindness; shared project/development familiarity remains disclosed by the frozen contract.

schema_clarification: The legacy required-fact status supported_correct records correctness against the frozen semantic reference. It does not by itself certify received-context support; support gaps are stated in fact rationales, citation_grounded, and unsupported_assertions. No frozen reference or input was changed.
axis_notes: Native output-budget failures are copied unchanged from the packet and judged separately from completed semantic assertions.
format_ok assesses readable prose and interpretable citations; parenthesized or grouped citations are accepted.

Explicit approximate qualification is required for rounded values when the frozen reference requires it. No absent totals, units, headers, or report periods are inferred from magnitude or prior knowledge.
appropriate_abstention records explicit withholding of unsupported requested content. False for a supported direct answer is not itself an error.

rubric_ambiguities.issue: Whether a volunteered, reference-correct causal connection is an essential assertion for grounding when the minimum required facts and all component facts are received but their causal bridge is absent.
rubric_ambiguities.applied_judgment: Treat the volunteered cause as material: citation_grounded=false while reference_content_correct=true. This preserves the unsupported-link annotation and does not add a required fact.
rubric_ambiguities.alternative_if_essential_means_minimum_f: This narrower interpretation was considered and rejected by root adjudication; no reference or required fact was changed.
rubric_ambiguities.root_adjudication: Resolved by root second look after this grader and a fresh-context second-look model had recorded the issue: citation grounding includes material volunteered assertions, not only the minimum required facts. Retain citation_grounded=false.
